fichas.title: Building permission and approval exemptions
fichas.summary: Building construction, alteration, or change of use generally requires approval from the building supervision authorities. The page describes approval-free projects, a building notification procedure, and the simplified approval process for certain buildings within a legally binding development plan.
uses: Assessing whether building approval is required
Applying approval exemptions and simplified approval procedures

fichas.title: Building permit application, issue, and authority supervision
fichas.summary: The building permit application is prepared with input from other specialists, submitted to the responsible council, and reviewed by the building control authority and other responsible parties. A preliminary decision may be sought on critical questions. Permits can be partial, and permits lapse if work does not start or is interrupted for the stated period. Authority supervision includes checks and final acceptance.
